Class XY

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.common.XY
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class XY extends Object implements Serializable
X and Y values for a point in a 2D cartesian coordinate system, i.e. x and y values on the X and Y axes. The directions and ranges of the x and y values is undefined. Use for analysis displays is as needed for the particular display. The CoordinateTransform class is provided to permit use of this XY coordinate system as a transform of another, e.g. Point2D coordinate system.

For example, a SysMLinJava model might use a typical cartesian coordinate system with some distance per x,y increment and the [0,0] point at the bottom left of the modeled space. An animated area display uses a pixel coordinate system with the pixel as the increment and the 0,0 pixel at the upper left of the pixel space. The CoordinateTransform could be used to transform Point2D positions in the model to XY pixels in the display.
